'''Fieler Dan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameLSmechanics}}
Fieler Dan was sent into the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] to try to locate the missing plans for secret tunnels running underneath [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When no word came from her to [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Doorn]], an individual was sent to find her. The individual found the plans and gave a copy to Dan so that she could pass them on to her [[Fieler Dan's daughter|daughter]]. Her daughter would use the plans to help bring in food and supplies for Coruscant's needy.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fieler Dan appears as part of the "Secret Passages" mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The player can choose to not let Dan make a copy as a dark side choice.<ref name="TOR" />
